_DspFixedWidthText.notes: A negative font: a font with foreground 0x142b41 on transparent is made first. Then DspText(AN, font, nWidth = 0 ? "" : sValue, nWidth, nAlignment, truncate 1, tooltip 1).

_DspObjectGetCursor.notes: 1 when the command cursor is on the object id's AN (without a window: when the id maps to -1).

_DspObjectGetCursorDown.notes: 1 when the object id's AN is the window's pressed AN (an id of 750+: when nothing is pressed... the pressed AN is -1).

_DspObjectGetCursorUp.notes: 1 when the command cursor is on the object id's AN and that AN is not pressed (window 0..19, id 0..; an id of 750+ maps to -1).

_LibControl_GetANName.notes: PageGetInt(">AN" + id, -1): the AN a Library_Controls control registered for itself.

_LibControl_GetInt.notes: atol(DspAnGetMetadata(PageGetInt(">AN" + id), field)) under ErrSet(1): a value whose first non-blank is not a digit, '-', '+' or the end raises 274 (swallowed); any error -> the default, IsError() 0 afterwards; a successful read restores the caller's earlier IsError() code. Neither the read's own error nor the restored code is reported again (the runtime logs them only with the DEBUG parameter 2).

_LibControl_GetStr.notes: DspAnGetMetadata(PageGetInt(">AN" + id), field) under ErrSet(1); any error -> the default and IsError() 0 afterwards; a successful read restores the caller's earlier IsError() code. Never halts. Neither the read's own error nor the restored code is reported again (the runtime logs them only with the DEBUG parameter 2).

_LibControl_StrArray_SetInt.notes: (the value right-aligned in its N characters)

_ObjectCallMethod.notes: ciText.ComboBox implements AddItem(item, optional index), RemoveItem(index) and Clear(). Other control methods return an empty string. An invalid handle raises 274.

_ObjectGetProperty.notes: Reads the control's stored property. ciText.ComboBox also exposes ListCount, zero-based ListIndex (-1 for no selection), and Text.

_ObjectServerInvoke.notes: Does nothing in the runtime either.

_ObjectServerInvokeEx.notes: Does nothing in the runtime either.

_ObjectSetProperty.notes: Stores a control property. On ciText.ComboBox, writing ListIndex selects a row and updates Text. Writing Text selects a matching row if present.

effects: shows the page in the task's window, a new history entry
errors: 256 the window is not open (raised and returned)
277 not in the user's area (returned, prompt 'Page is out of your Area')
318 too many nested page changes and 517 a change from the window's own scan (raised and returned)
_PageDisplay.notes: Include's PageDisplay calls it. The forward entries of the history are dropped, the page appended; the page list holds the page once. The cluster argument is not used (one simulated cluster).

effects: shows the page in the task's window in place of the current history entry
errors: 256 the window is not open (raised and returned)
_PageGoto.notes: Include's PageGoto calls it. No new history entry: the current one becomes the new page (the runtime replaces the entry at the position; an empty history gets the page).

_RunTest.notes: Undocumented: runs one of the display client's built-in unit tests (GetEffectsModeOfObject4..9, TestWindowCloseButton, TestRemovingDuplicateSeperatorFromSystemMenu, without case). The tests check Windows window chrome and are not run: 0 for those names (verify), -1 for an empty or other name, as the runtime.

_RunTests.notes: Undocumented: runs every built-in unit test and writes a summary file; neither is done here: 0.

_TimeSub.notes: Include labels: TimeHour 0, TimeMin 1, TimeSec 2, DateDay 3, DateWeekDay 4 (1 = Sunday), DateMonth 5, DateYear 6 (two digits), TimeMidNight 7, DateYearDay 8 (0-based), 9 full year, 10 days in the month; local time.

_VbCicodeCallReturn.notes: No CiVBA in the simulator: nothing to return to.

_Wave.notes: Test signal on the millisecond counter: iType 0 sine, 1 square, 2 triangle, 3 sawtooth, 4 random walk (the CRT rand of the VM); period iTime seconds (at least 1), phase in seconds; (iHigh - min(iLow, iHigh)) * v + min(iLow, iHigh), truncated.

effects: sets the task's window's title
_WinTitle.notes: Include's WinTitle(sTitle) calls it. The title stays until a page is displayed in the window (the page scan's title, waits on the flag it sets). Returns 0.

__ObjectMasterAN.notes: Undocumented: a process table of 16-bit values (table, index 0..749, the runtime's 0x2ee entries a table): Value 0 or less reads the entry; another value stores it and gives it back. An index of 750 or more -1.

__TabAlarm_GetIDByAN.notes: PageGetInt("_tabalm_AN<nListAN>_ID", -1): the id a Tab style alarm list registered for its AN; -1 for an AN below 1.

__Tabmenu_GetMenuConfigDisabled.notes: Tab_Style's helper: the node's DISABLED configuration evaluated, 1 / 0 (guess from the name; undocumented).

rdbGetPath.notes: Undocumented. The search path's folders joined by ';' (255 characters at most here: the runtime's buffer is 256 bytes). Before any rdbSetPath: the unit's root project folder (guess: the runtime sets it from the run path at start; verify).

effects: sets the process's compiled-database search path
rdbSetPath.notes: Undocumented. The ';'-separated folders, each without its trailing '\', duplicates (without case) and empty entries dropped, 1027 at most (more: 0 and the path stays empty). 1 when it was taken. The simulator keeps reading the unit's compiled files: the path is only remembered (rdbGetPath).
